searchText: Hey, hoping this is the right channel But had a question regarding eth2. And was wondering, if one were to stake using something like RoxketPool. And then decide to take their staking balance and run their own node instead. Would you essentially have to “re-stake”? Shoot, validator support channel may have been better. Sorry about that I should have mentioned this a few weeks ago when I thought of it but I think the members of this discord should be much more conservative about where the public invite links are shared. It's going to become unmanageable pretty fast. I would not share invite links on twitter, or reddit for that matter, only in DMs for people who are genuinely interested in discussion or observing. Otherwise this becomes a helpdesk or people asking "when phase 0???" "When EIP 1559???" The alternative is to more rigorously enforce off-topic bans. Yeah I think it's a fine line: you don't want people to feel like things are happening "behind closed doors", but at the same time you don't want spam either. I'd be happy to more rigorously enforce off-topic bans. Can people be blocked from specific channels? I feel like especially since 1559 got a large community grant there's a sort of duty to keep things open, but there is a point where it becomes counterproductive 😅 I would think my question is a pretty legitimate question pertinent to eth2. I wasn’t asking about dates or anything perhaps more of a question for the Staking as a Service folks though. I will ask there was not necessarily related to your comment <@!379074217326673920> you can check out the ETHstakers community as well > https://discord.gg/zeGaxc thank you :] Just my two gwei but I always thought a read only chat would be a good solution for the problem you were talking about above. It’s open so nothing is behind closed doors. But also read only access to majority of folks so you don’t have ppl like me chiming in :p How gas fee apply to the transaction ? Means wallet to wallet gas fee rule ? Wallet to smart contract gas fee rules ? Contract to contract gas fee rule? Please answer this question How much gas fee apply to a smart contract to create baby contract address ?
